entries.name: Daro3835
entries.evidence: Khusnutdinova et al. 2023 FEBS J, doi 10.1111/febs.16903; PDB 8SDC / 8SDD. UniProt PE 1 -- and annotated ONLY as "Alpha/beta hydrolase fold protein", with NO EC number.

entries.name: DehH2 (H-2)
entries.evidence: Kawasaki et al. 1992. UniProt carries EC 3.8.1.3, but the entry itself states the enzyme acts on chloro-, bromo- and iodoacetate, NOT on fluoroacetate. HAD superfamily (PF00702), not alpha/beta hydrolase.

entries.name: Alr0039 (NOS0089)
entries.evidence: PDB 3QYJ (Petit, Kagan, Yakunin & Savchenko), deposited as "putative alpha/beta hydrolase", primary citation "to be published". UniProt PE 4, NO EC number, name "Alr0039 protein". The structure exists; NO assay on fluoroacetate is documented in a public source we could verify. Listed as a candidate, NOT as a characterised positive -- promote it only against a paper that reports the measured activity.

entries.name: LGL-1
entries.evidence: Ji et al. 2026, Chem Sci 17:13816, doi 10.1039/d6sc02671k. Reclassified defluorinase; 2.7-fold greater defluorination activity than Q6NAM1. Public annotation before the assay: GO:0047372, monoacylglycerol lipase activity.

entries.name: LGL-2
entries.evidence: Ji et al. 2026, Chem Sci 17:13816. Reclassified defluorinase, assayed on 2-fluoro-2-phenylacetate.
